description: An outdoor terrace scene photographed at dusk, with a warm amber sunset sky visible beyond a low stucco parapet wall. The terrace floor is laid in large-format limestone-toned pavers with subtle variation in tone. A naturally weathered round wooden table with a raw-edged slab surface occupies the left foreground, accompanied by a matching low rustic wooden stool. On the table rests a woven jute placemat, a loosely draped linen throw with fringe edges, a small ceramic vase with dried botanicals, and a few matte stoneware cups. To the right, a natural rattan armchair with a loose linen cushion and a draped grid-weave throw anchors the right side of the composition. A potted plant with white blooms in a woven basket sits at the base of the chair. The stucco parapet wall behind has a warm sand plaster finish; dappled shadows from overhead tree branches play across its surface. Dense Mediterranean shrubbery and a gnarled tree trunk frame the upper edges of the scene against the peach-and-rose dusk sky. A warm amber glow pools on the paver floor between the furniture pieces, radiating outward and softening the transition from the dusky ambient blue. Camera is at standing eye-level, slightly above, with a normal-to-wide lens offering a three-quarter view of the terrace corner showing both seating areas and the parapet backdrop. The scene reads casual and serene, evoking a slow Mediterranean evening. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
